reflectionQuestion: If you had to name three good things about today, what would they be?
title: Three Good Things
reflectionText:
Priya thought her day had nothing good in it. But when she looked harder, good things were everywhere — warm light, gentle rain, a sticky hug from her little sister, honey on toast.

Sometimes the best things in a day are the small ones we almost miss. What good things might be hiding in your day right now?
